This supplement reports the full posterior summaries for the four Bayesian
multilevel models in the main manuscript: M1 (total playtime REWB), M2
(preregistered independent-coefficient genre model), M3 (hierarchical prior genre
model), and M4 (multi-membership genre model). All four use the `brms` default priors. M3's hierarchical prior on the genre
coefficients is estimated in non-centred form, as two multi-membership genre terms
weighted by the genre exposures, so its spreads τ are `brms` group-level standard
deviations with the default half-Student-t(3, 0, 2.5) prior (manuscript, Appendix F). Models are loaded from the
cached fits in `models/`; to regenerate them, render `manuscript.qmd`.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(glue)
library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(tinytable)

h1_model      <- readRDS(here("models/h1_rewb_model.rds"))
h2_model      <- readRDS(here("models/h2_genre_model.rds"))
h2_hier_model <- readRDS(here("models/h2_hier_model_v4.rds"))
h2_mm_model   <- readRDS(here("models/h2_mm_model_full.rds"))

# Convert summary(brmsfit) into a single tidy table with grouped sections
# (population-level effects, group-level effects per grouping factor, and
# family-specific parameters), rendered with tinytable. Derived quantities
# (M3's per-genre coefficients, computed draw-wise) are absent from summary()
# and can be appended via extra_draws, a draws_df summarised directly;
# group_labels renames grouping factors (M3's long mm group names).
brms_summary_tt <- function(model, extra_draws = NULL, extra_section = NULL,
                            group_labels = NULL) {
  s <- summary(model)
  if (!is.null(group_labels)) {
    stopifnot(all(names(group_labels) %in% names(s$random)))
    names(s$random)[match(names(group_labels), names(s$random))] <- group_labels
  }

  tidy_section <- function(df, section) {
    df |>
      tibble::rownames_to_column("Parameter") |>
      as_tibble() |>
      mutate(section = section)
  }

  sections <- list(tidy_section(s$fixed, "Population-level effects"))
  for (g in names(s$random)) {
    sections <- c(sections, list(
      tidy_section(s$random[[g]], glue("Group-level effects: {g}"))
    ))
  }
  sections <- c(sections, list(
    tidy_section(s$spec_pars, "Family-specific parameters")
  ))

  if (!is.null(extra_draws)) {
    extra <- posterior::summarise_draws(
      extra_draws,
      Estimate = mean, Est.Error = sd,
      ~posterior::quantile2(.x, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)),
      Rhat = posterior::rhat,
      Bulk_ESS = posterior::ess_bulk, Tail_ESS = posterior::ess_tail
    ) |>
      rename(Parameter = variable, `l-95% CI` = q2.5, `u-95% CI` = q97.5) |>
      mutate(section = extra_section)
    sections <- c(sections, list(extra))
  }

  combined <- bind_rows(sections) |>
    transmute(
      section,
      Parameter,
      Estimate     = sprintf("%.3f", Estimate),
      `Est. error` = sprintf("%.3f", Est.Error),
      `95% CI`     = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", `l-95% CI`, `u-95% CI`),
      `R-hat`      = sprintf("%.3f", Rhat),
      `Bulk ESS`   = sprintf("%d", round(Bulk_ESS)),
      `Tail ESS`   = sprintf("%d", round(Tail_ESS))
    )

  # Row indices where each section starts (for tinytable group headers)
  group_starts <- combined |>
    mutate(row = row_number()) |>
    group_by(section) |>
    summarise(start = min(row), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(start)
  group_i <- as.list(group_starts$start)
  names(group_i) <- group_starts$section

  combined |>
    select(-section) |>
    tt() |>
    group_tt(i = group_i) |>
    format_tt(escape = TRUE) |>
    style_tt(i = 0, bold = TRUE)
}
```

# M1: Total Playtime (H1)

```{r}
#| label: tbl-supp-m1
#| tbl-cap: "Full posterior summary for M1 (total playtime REWB model). Estimates are posterior means with 95% credible intervals; R-hat and effective sample sizes (ESS) are convergence diagnostics."

brms_summary_tt(h1_model)
```

# M2: Pre-Registered Independent Genre Coefficients (H2)

```{r}
#| label: tbl-supp-m2
#| tbl-cap: "Full posterior summary for M2 (preregistered independent-coefficient genre model). Genre parameters are labelled `gh_{genre}_within` and `gh_{genre}_between` for the within- and between-person exposure terms."

brms_summary_tt(h2_model)
```

# M3: Hierarchical Prior (H2)

```{r}
#| label: tbl-supp-m3
#| tbl-cap: "Full posterior summary for M3 (hierarchical prior genre model), estimated in non-centred form. `sum_within` and `sum_between` are the common genre effects γ~W~ and γ~B~ (the centres of the distributions from which the genre coefficients are drawn), estimated as slopes on the summed genre exposures; the standard deviations of the two genre terms are τ~within~ and τ~between~, the spread of the genre coefficients around them. The genre coefficients `gh_{genre}_within` and `gh_{genre}_between` are γ plus each genre's deviation, computed at each posterior draw."

# Non-centred M3 (manuscript chunk h2-hier-fit): beta_g = gamma + r_g, with
# gamma = b_sum_* and r_g the multi-membership genre intercepts.
m3_vars <- brms::variables(h2_hier_model)
m3_group <- function(prefix) {
  hit <- grep(sprintf("^sd_mm%s1%s2.*__Intercept$", prefix, prefix), m3_vars, value = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(hit) == 1)
  sub("^sd_(.*)__Intercept$", "\\1", hit)
}
m3_gw <- m3_group("gW_")
m3_gb <- m3_group("gB_")
m3_r  <- function(g) m3_vars[startsWith(m3_vars, paste0("r_", g, "["))]
m3_lev <- function(cols, g) sub(",Intercept\\]$", "", sub(paste0("r_", g, "["), "", cols, fixed = TRUE))
m3_rw <- m3_r(m3_gw)
m3_rb <- m3_r(m3_gb)
stopifnot(length(m3_rw) == 14, length(m3_rb) == 14,
          identical(m3_lev(m3_rw, m3_gw), m3_lev(m3_rb, m3_gb)))
m3_genres <- m3_lev(m3_rw, m3_gw)
m3_dr <- posterior::as_draws_df(h2_hier_model,
                                variable = c("b_sum_within", "b_sum_between", m3_rw, m3_rb))
m3_beta <- c(
  setNames(lapply(m3_rw, function(v) m3_dr$b_sum_within + m3_dr[[v]]),
           paste0("gh_", m3_genres, "_within")),
  setNames(lapply(m3_rb, function(v) m3_dr$b_sum_between + m3_dr[[v]]),
           paste0("gh_", m3_genres, "_between"))
)
m3_beta_draws <- posterior::as_draws_df(as.data.frame(c(
  m3_beta, list(.chain = m3_dr$.chain, .iteration = m3_dr$.iteration, .draw = m3_dr$.draw)
)))

brms_summary_tt(h2_hier_model,
                extra_draws   = m3_beta_draws,
                extra_section = "Genre coefficients (γ + genre deviation, per draw)",
                group_labels  = setNames(c("genre, within-person (sd = τ within)",
                                           "genre, between-person (sd = τ between)"),
                                         c(m3_gw, m3_gb)))
```

# M4: Multi-Membership (H2)

```{r}
#| label: tbl-supp-m4
#| tbl-cap: "Full posterior summary for M4 (multi-membership genre model). Group-level standard deviations for the `mm()` term are the genre heterogeneity parameters (σ~s~ within and between)."

brms_summary_tt(h2_mm_model)
```
